balls.text: run-out again, as Pant hits this time! He had his right glove off already, as Bhuvneshwar swung to this fullish ball outside off, as the batters took off to try and steal a bye. But Sandeep is far from the crease at the keeper's end, as Pant strikes and finds him short
goes for the slog to this slower ball on a fullish length outside off, and misses. Pan throws back, but misses the stumps at his end

run-out at the keeper's end! Good work by the substitute fielder Smith at long-on. Very full ball outside off, and Rashid drags that to long-on with a flat bat. There was some confusion among the batters for once, which means Rashid is late on to the keeper's end, by which time Pant has already whipped off the stumps
another yorker just outside off, and this time Rashid jams that to the man at point
yorker just outside off. Dug out late with the open face of the bat to third man
goes inside out over mid-off, and gets four! Good length ball on off, and he uses his bottom hand to lift that for useful runs
another wide, this time down the leg side. Fullish length on middle and leg, and angles down further for a wide
good length ball and wide of off. Bhuvi plays away from his body to try and slash, but misses. It is a wide though. He wanted a single, but is sent back
slower ball again, and full length just outside off. Gets an under-edge to the keeper as he tries to slog to the on side
change of pace, but swung away over the keeper! Another short delivery on middle, and it is a legcutter. But Rashid goes for everything, and gets a top edge to this pull, as Pant gives up the chase
goes for a wild swing to this short ball on middle by clearing front leg, but is beaten by the bounce
just clears third man! Goes deep in his crease, and slashes at that short ball outside off. The pace means the ball travels rather quickly
top-edged, and gone! Slower ball on this occasion, and on a short of a length just outside off. Samad pulls, but gets a top edge, as Pant takes a few steps to his left to complete a comfortable catch
slammed over the bowler's head! On a good length on off, and he clears his front leg while also sitting deep in his crease to slice that back for four

and another short ball to keep the batter in check. Bowled short and a touch wide of off at 147kph, Rashid swings and misses. A brilliant spell for Nortje comes to an end, as he finishes with 2 for 12
makes room, and skips down too, but misses his heave. Short delivery again on middle, and climbing on to the batter, who misses his slog
short of a length ball outside off, and pulled to long-on on the bounce. Looked like he got that from the higher side of the bat
yorker length ball on middle and leg at 149kph. Again Rashid backs away, and this time hoicks it to deep square leg off the inside half of the bat
almost a collision between Dhawan and Hetmyer at third man. Very full ball outside off, and Rashid swings over short third man while giving himself room
looks to guide that short of a length ball on middle at 143kph, but is beaten. Rashid was outside leg while dabbing at that, with the good bounce meaning he is not in control
crashed over long-on! Stays deep in his crease to this low full-toss just outside off, and swings that away full stretch with his front foot across off too. Maximum from the free-hit
almost a yorker-length ball and a touch outside off. He opens the bat face to guide that to third man. No-ball too, and it was tight as well
goes slashing at this very full and wide ball outside off, but gets underedge, as the ball trickles to Pant behind
very full delivery on off, and in the slot too. He is deep in his crease, but can only drive that down to mid-off
short of a length and wide of off. Change of pace too, as Samad pulls it to long-on while playing away from his body
very full and just outside off at 139kph. Samad goes for the heave across the line, but finds Smith - the substitute fielder - at midwicket right at the edge of the circle
bottom edge, but just past his stumps! Looks to chop that good length ball just outside off, but is lucky that it doesn't disturb his stumps
good length ball on off, and pushed to the left of the man at cover
outside edge, and four down to third man. Ashwin gives the chase, but doesn't catch up. Another ball skids on from a good length on middle and off, and there is an outside edge off his drive
full delivery just outside off, and driven with the full face of the bat to deep point
this sneaks in quicker, off a fullish length on middle. Dragged toward point
full ball on off, and tapped toward cover off the front foot

down the track, and chipped to cover! Full delivery pitching slightly wide of off, with a hint of turn away from the right-hander. But with Holder already out of his crease, he has a go at that, only to lob it to Shaw at cover. Another blow for Sunrisers
short delivery to end the over. Pitches it short on middle and off, and he misses his pull, with the ball getting good bounce off the surface
goes inside out over cover to this full just outside off, and lands it safe to the right of deep point despite playing aerially. Iyer throws at the bowler's end, but Holder is in on time
dabs this good length ball outside off to third man
Goes for the heave to the on side, but gets a leading edge for six over third man! Full ball in the slot on off, and whack!
Holder makes room outside leg, as Rabada goes full outside off. It is a no-ball too
goes for the slog to this good length ball on off, but gets it off the inside half of the bat to deep square leg
good, hard length on off. Clipped to fine leg with a skip in the crease
Ashwin across the umpire to bowl this full on off. Driven down to long-on

reverse-sweep to short third man, and is Holder run-out? Nope, he is in on time. Good, quick throw from Nortje back to the keeper, as it is close to the stumps. But Holder is back in before Pant destroys the stumps
turns into the batter after pitching on middle and off, as it is dabbed toward cover
on the bounce to long-on! Goes for the heave to this full ball on off, but cannot find the connection
He goes across off and opens himself up. It is a good length ball on middle and off, and he guides that to deep midwicket
good length ball just outside off, pushed to deep midwicket

rapped in front, and given leg before! But Jadhav challenges that decision. A good length ball on off, and angling into the batter a little. He goes to flick but misses, as the ball strikes his front pad. No inside edge there. Pitches just outside off and angles in, with replays showing that would have crashed into middle. Sunrisers have now lost half their side with not too many on the board
another good length ball, but this is a touch wide of off. Cut unconvincingly to point for another dot ball
has a jab at that good length ball outside off, which is also angling away. But he plays without much foot movement, and is beaten
pretty full ball on off at 148kph. Driven down to long-on
good length ball on off, and that is guided to third man from close to his body
full length ball in the slot on off, and hoicked across the line to deep square leg. Starts with a 145kph ball straightaway
good length delivery again on middle and leg, and clipped to deep square leg
fuller and outside off, driven down to long-on. The man at cover dives to his right, but he was far from the ball, and Pant has a chuckle
cuts from really close to the keeper's gloves, and plays late to this fullish ball outside off, but finds short third man
another chip to deep square leg. Good length ball on middle, and he again pushes that aerially to the on side
on a good length just outside off, clipped behind the wicket toward fine leg with the closed face of the bat
very full on middle and leg, and chipped to deep square leg
short of a length ball in the channel outside off at 141kph. Good bounce generated too, as Kedar decides to let that go after thinking of a poke for once
pulls his length back on off stump, as Samad pushes that down to long-on
slower ball. Full length ball just outside off - and in the slot too - as he tries swinging for the hills, but is beaten completely by the lack of pace

misfield by Hetmyer at deep square, and that allows an extra two runs. It was a low full-toss on off, perhaps an attempted yorker, as Samad flicked that low off the front foot. Two bonus runs for him there
full length ball, and in the driving length just outside off. Driven with the full face of the bat to mid-off

leading edge, and nabbed by Rabada! Good length ball on middle and seemed to be angling in too, as he tries to clip that away to the on side, but instead balloons it back to the bowler, who takes a few steps to his right to complete an easy take. He is now on a hat-trick too
good length, outside off. Cut to deep point for a single. Sunrisers 61/3 after ten

Third time unlucky! Rides the luck, and this time it ends. Not as full as Williamson thought. Comes down the ground but doesn't get to the pitch of the ball. Struck in the air, and Hetmyer at long off runs to his right to take a catch. That's three down
dropped by Shaw! Another life for the nicest man in cricket. Full outside off. Driven with the turn, and straight to Shaw. But it pops out after he gets both hands
fullish outside off stump. Brings the drive out through the off side to deep extra cover
chipped and it lands just short of Hetmyer at long off. Full just outside off and gently lofted over Axar. Hit a bit harder and that was out
good length on off, and tapped with gentle hands to cover

dropped by the captain! Full ball, slightly wider. Carrom ball turning away. Williamson presses forward to defend, takes the edge, and it hits Pant's webbing before going to ground! Ashwin's stoic, no strong reaction, takes the cap and walks back
good length on off and angling into middle. Defended
comes from wide of the crease this time. Length ball just outside off, and worked off his waist to square leg. Williamson wanted two, but Pandey wasn't interested
quicker ball. Flicks it out of the finger. Length ball, wide outside off, and flat-batted over the umpire for four!
slower through the air. Full on middle, and paddle swept to short fine leg. But it's a no ball from the perfectionist
overcompensates by going further outside off. Doesn't turn in. Misses the cut. Umpire calls it a wide
good length outside off. Turning into KW. He gets onto the back foot and flicks it through midwicket to the gap at cow corner. Long on and deep midwicket can't cut it off
good length outside off and Williamson cuts it rather unconvincingly. In the air, loops over the fielder at cover, lands safe in the end. Fielder in the deep cleans up
full on leg and he walks down the wicket before working it off his pads to deep backward square leg
sees the batter giving him a charge and Axar goes for a full and wide ball. But Manish reaches out and drags a shot down to long on
good length, outside off stump. Shuffles onto the leg side and cuts to Anrich at deep extra cover
good length outside off. Angling in thereafter. He backs away and punches to cover
full outside off. He comes down the track, and effectively yorks himself. Slogs a whippy shot to midwicket
full outside off. Bit of turn away. Slaps a drive to Hetmyer at cover
good length outside off. Rolls his fingers over the ball. Manish adjusts the flat-batted shot he was shaping up to play and ends up nudging it down the ground to long on
tries the slower ball yorker. Dips into his toes on middle stump, and flicked to Dhawan at deep midwicket again. They need to hurry for the second run though

good length ball outside off. Williamson charges and then bunts a cut in front of square. Looks like it will beat Shaw at cover, but he commits to the dive to stop the ball from rolling away! Full marks for commitment
full on middle. In the slot, and he chooses to flick it through the infield to Dhawan manning the deep midwicket boundary
fullish ball on middle, and angling into leg. KW wants to flick it square, but can't connect. Hits the front pad and rolls away to the on-side
full on off stump, and he pushes a drive back past the non-striker to mid on
good length ball angling into him. Williamson shapes up to place a pull very fine, but Nortje runs to his left at short fine leg to dive and intercept. Avesh gets away
good length, just outside off stump. Rides the bounce and fends it to the off side
A crisp front-foot cover drive to this full ball. But stopped by cover
back of a length outside off. Stays on the back foot and guides a late cut to third man
full on off, and flicked to the gap at midwicket. Ashwin has to run around from mid on to grab that
full just outside off, and he drives straight. But the power isn't at 100%. Avesh gets a hand to it, slowing the ball down. And mid off intercepts

mistimed pull and taken by Dhawan. Back of a length outside off. Saha tries to drag a pull but the ball rises on him, and he ends up slicing the shot. Dhawan tracks the ball over his shoulders from midwicket, and then does the Thigh Five to celebrate.
full and wide outside off. Saha reaches out to drive, but can't get there. Through to Pant, and inside the tramlines too. Dot ball.
length ball, with a bit of width. Cut to cover point, where Shaw is lurking. Has a shy at the bowler's end for a direct hit with Williamson just out of his crease
short ball outside off. Saha gets in position for the pull early, but it's a cutter from Rabada taking the pace off. Saha can't connect, on the bounce to Pant
fullish just outside off stump. Defended off the front foot
full on off, and he uses his wrists to flick it behind square for a first-ball six! In front of his toes, and that's a trademark Saha flick. A flourish of the wrists to cap that shot off
good length, outside off. Backs away and plays the cut behind square. Dhawan at point
full on middle, and he clips it off his pads to square leg for another one
full on off. Comes down the wicket and tucks it away to square leg
full just outside off stump. Defended back off the front foot
quicker ball. Length ball outside off and angling into off. Punched off the back foot to cover
slog swept first ball! Full outside off from around the stumps. Saha goes down on one onee and drags a shot to the cow corner boundary

yorker length, lands on leg stump. Saha misses the flick, it hits the boot, and the ball rolls down to third man. LBW appeal turned down and can't review either. This was going down the leg side anyway
good length just outside off. Stands tall and plays a punchy shot to the off side. Rolls away to Iyer at cover
good length ball on middle. Angling into his hips, and flicked to the gap at square leg for a comfortable single
full on off, and he drives it comfortably past the non-striker. Rabada manning that region at mid on though
full on off, and he nudges a guided flick to midwicket, which is vacant
length ball angling into him, and worked away off his hips to deep backward square leg for one
good length outside off stump. Tries to cut again, this time Avesh takes the pace off. Through the shot a tad early

just past point! Width offered, Avesh always bowls with pace with the new ball anyway. Saha rocks back, and slaps it square past Axar diving to his right. Sunrisers need more of these from Saha in the powerplay
good length outside off stump. Cuts it square, but doesn't have the placement. Axar at point
good length just outside off stump. Opens the bat's face and runs it down to third man
good length ball outside off stump. Angling into Saha, and worked of his waist to square leg for a single
full just outside off. Smothered off the front foot, to Ashwin at wide mid on
full on middle, and angling down leg. Williamson flicks it off his hips, and that's raced away to fine leg for four. Easy for Williamson to put it there with the pace Nortje is offering

is that lbw? Fullish on off and nipping into him. Presses forward to defend, and its hit his pad! Given not out. Was there an inside edge? Pant has a long thought, with Iyer next to him, and then he decides to review! Poor call, clear inside edge onto his front leg. Capitals lose the review early into the innings.
full on off and that's been caressed down the ground, past the non-striker. Mid on dives to his left, but can't stop it. Stoinis from mid off runs to the boundary to send it back

Warner's horror time in the IPL continues! Back of a length on leg stump. It's angling into Warner, and he looks to work it to square leg off the back foot. But the ball seams away (just that extra bit) at the last moment, takes the leading edge, and pops up for point to get under it.
good length on off. Tapped after a tentative shuffle, ball rolls away to cover
wide yorker outside off stump. Warner can't connect with the drive given that length. Through to Pant. Close to 150kph!

hammers this pull over long-on! Iyer dances around in his crease to first hint to come down, and then steps across to this shortish ball outside off. Absolutely slams that beyond the fence, as Sunrisers crumble to their seventh loss in eight games with Capitals' eight-wicket win
good length ball on off, and finds short midwicket with his pull
slower ball, and a low full-toss on middle and leg. Flicked to deep midwicket
beats mid-off with that crunching drive! The fielder dives to his right, but is beaten. Pant uses his bottom hand to this really full outside off, and caresses that for four
slower ball again, but on a good length outside off. Goes for the cut, but gets it off the bottom of the bat toward cover
starts with a slower ball, but this is full and pitching on leg. Angles down leg further, and is called wide

cracked over deep square leg! Another short ball, and with change of pace too. At just 109kph, and short at middle and off, Pant clears his front leg, and smokes this pull for the maximum. That brings up the fifty stand too
beats short fine leg to his right! Rolls his wrists with this pull to this short ball on off. It is a slower ball too, but Pant still times that well and along the ground for four
change of pace again. On a good length outside off, and like he has all along, Iyer dabs it to third man
slower ball and short of a length again outside off. Pulled to fine leg with a swivel
good delivery, with good bounce. Back of a length and just outside off, as Pant misses his slash playing after making room
short ball again, but this is wide of off. Pant goes for the pull with his bottom hand off, but the ball is wide off him, and also gets good bounce. Wide called
very full and pitches wide of leg. Pant goes for the flick, but that is pretty wide of him, and is called one
short ball again to Pant on off, and he mistimes the pull. Holder at long-on runs to his left to stop the ball, and Pant bags two
good length ball on middle, and comes back into the batter. Slower ball too at 118kph, as it is dabbed toward cover with his bottom hand off
good length ball and wide of off. Pulled to long-on away from his body
short ball again, and pulled to deep midwicket. Rashid runs and dives to his right, and keeps that down to a single. Excellent fielding

short ball on middle, and pulled high over deep square leg! Change of pace too, but Pant is deep in his crease to hammer that pull. Looked like Pant was anticipating that ball already, and slammed that away

just evades the leaping short midwicket fielder! He runs to his left and stretches out his left hand, but that is pretty wide of him. Good length ball on off, and pushed from the higher side of the ball
short delivery on middle, and pulled to deep square with a swivel, and with his eyes taken off the ball
shorter in length on middle, and clipped toward midwicket. The fielder there is quick to intercept, and stops a single
full and pitches wide of leg. Called wide
Iyer takes off, but no run there. Full ball on off, and he taps that to cover
skips down to tap this full ball outside off toward cover. Quick single is gobbled
very full on off, and pushed back to the bowler. Rashid has to rush forward to stop that
appeal for caught behind by Saha, as Pant misses his cut off this short and wide ball outside off
very full on middle and leg, and clipped to deep square
low full-toss on middle, perhaps in search of the yorker. Clipped behind to fine leg
yorker length just outside off, and jammed back to Pandey at shortish midwicket after stepping across
very Kohli-like this time! Another full ball on off, and he closes the bat face to play this flick to deep midwicket with soft hands
short delivery on off, and picks that up early to slog that pull to deep midwicket. It was a knuckle ball, and read well
Pant takes off for a single, but Pandey at midwicket misses the direct hit at the bowler's end! Fuller ball on off, and Iyer drove it right down. Could have been out had he hit
on a good length on off, and clips this slower ball to deep square leg. Very quick running to complete the second there
good length ball on off, and again Iyer is happy to tap that to third man to keep rotating the strike

leading edge, but short of mid-off! Looks to clip this full ball on middle and off, but doesn't get the connection. He takes off for a single immediately, and Warner doesn't hit at the bowler's end as Pant dives for live
outside edge, and flies to third man. Goes to slash this fullish ball slightly wide of off, but can only run that down to straightish third man
goes down on his back knee, and sweeps this good length ball on middle to deep square leg after making some room
fullish in length on off, and angling in. Clipped to the man at shortish midwicket
on a good length and wide of off. Iyer opens the bat face to dab that to third man
takes a slight step across to this short of a length ball on middle and off, and pulls to deep square leg from deep in his crease
short and wide of off, and cut to point on the bounce. There is a fumble there, which allows a single
slower ball, and hammered over the umpire! That was right in the slot on off, and Pant cleared his front leg to slam that back
good length ball on middle and off. He waits for it to come, and opens the bat face to dab that toward the man at wide-ish slip
skips down right away, and there is a swing and a miss! Fullish ball on middle, and angling away, as Pant is down the track and slogs from leg stump
pretty full ball just outside off. Iyer presents the full face of the bat to drive down to long-on
very full on off, and he opens the bat face to run that toward point

taken at deep square leg! Flatter and quicker on middle, with the ball turning into him off a full length at middle. Dhawan goes down on his back knee to sweep, but mistimes it, and with the longer boundary there, finds the fielder
slower and full on off, blocked off the front foot
full on off again, and driven to long-on
very full on off, and dragged to long-off after making room
good length ball on off, punched down to long-on
good length, on off. Mistimes a cut, to point
up and over! Shot of the day. Full ball on off, but he uses the bottom hand to shovel a shot over cover. Doesn't overhit it, and it rolls away past the long off fielder trying to cut it off
low full toss on middle. Was meant to be a full ball but Dhawan presses forward and sweeps it beautifully behind square for four! Brilliantly timed. Off the sweet spot of the bat
overpitched outside off stump. Goes for a sloggy shot over wide long on, but can't connect. Past the edge to Saha
full on off stump. Caressed down the ground to long on, just past the stumps. Single
good length on middle stump. Punched off the back foot to mid on. But midwicket runs to his left to cut it off
good length on off. Turning into middle. Dhawan comes down the track to hit it straight down, but it takes an edge and gets stuck in his pad's pouch
full on middle. Driven inside out to long off for a single
dispatched! And into the VIP stand. Full outside off, the googly turns in, and Iyer is ready for exactly that. Big stride forward to get closer to the ball, and swept over cow corner for six
just past the outside edge. The legbreak just outside off stump. Iyer thought the googly would turn in.
fullish, on off stump. Bends his knees and cuts behind point. Late into the shot
full just outside off. Looks to drive, but the shot's been squirted behind point instead. Fielder runs around to intercept
full and wide outside off. Tries to drive through the off side but inside-edged onto his pads instead. Time out
full toss on off as Dhawan backs away to the leg side to make room. Slapped to deep extra cover for a couple and that's the team fifty
Full toss outside off stump. Driven towards Williamson at cover
fullish, outside off stump. Cutter goes away from Dhawan as he looks to slog sweep. Through to the keeper. Saha standing up to Dhawan again
keeper goes back. Good length ball just outside off. Pushed to long on for a single
keeper standing up. Good length on middle, and he pulls this tricky height delivery to deep midwicket. Two fielders congregating to cut it off. Saves one
wild shot. Down the wrong line by a mile. Fullish, very wide outside off. He tries to tonk a golf swing over long on. Misses out completely
full ball on middle and leg. Dhawan comes down the track and yorks himself by mistake. Dug away to sweeper fielder on the off side
good length, outside leg stump. Angling into middle. Spongy bounce, chest high for Dhawan. Looks to defend off the back foot, but gloved onto his body instead
good length, outside leg stump. Swivels, and gently places the grounded pull behind square on the leg side. Fielder in the deep has no chance
good length outside leg and angling into off. He comes down the track and mistimes a cut towards short cover
good length, outside off stump. Tap and run to cover point
fullish, on off stump. Pushed to cover. Rashid concedes ten and Capitals are 39 for 1 after the powerplay
full on middle, and turning into leg. Goes onto the back foot and punches one away with the turn to deep midwicket
full outside leg. Turning in slightly. Worked off the back foot to square leg
full on leg stump. Beautifully slog swept to deep midwicket for half a dozen. In position early, down on one knee, and he holds the pose after swatting the ball away
full on middle. Stays on the leg side of the ball and whips a straight shot to wide long on
good length, on middle and turning into leg. Pulls along the ground to deep square leg
taps this slower ball to short cover. Takes off for a single. But Jadhav quickly attacks the ball, and then takes an aim at the bowler's end for the run-out. But not a direct hit!
good length, on middle and angling across to off. Looks to punch through cover but off the bat's top half to mid on instead
back of a length outside off. Looks to drag a pull from outside off. But bottom-edged onto his body. Rolls away to short third man and they scurry across for one
good length just outside off stump. Iyer inside-edges a defensive shot onto his pads
full just outside off stump. Pushes a drive to cover. Stopped by Warner on his drive
just past the outside edge as he starts off with the leg cutter. Good length just outside off and moves away after hitting the deck. Looked to poke at it, but couldn't get any connection
good length, on off and angling across. Slaps a cut to cover point
nudged off his toes to the leg side for a single
hammered off the front foot. Full ball outside off, and he's powerfully smacked it back past the non-striker and beating mid off as well
full just outside off. The cutter jags in. Nudges a defensive shot towards midwicket's right for a single
good length outside off stump. Bit of extra bounce as Iyer looks to poke at it. Past the outside edge to Saha
full on off and angling into middle stump. Flicked to deep midwicket, where Samad runs around to intercept
full and wide outside off. Dhawan drives to cover point, but intercepted inside the circle

sliding catch by the captain! Full outside off. Angling further away. Shaw looks to drag a slog to deep midwicket but ends up dragging it to mid on's right. Williamson runs towards long on, uses his knees to slide along the grass, and completes the catch rather comfortably. Shaw gone for 11.
slower ball, back of a length on leg stump and a loopy delivery trajectory from Khaleel. Looks to pull, but misses
top edge over the keeper for four! Good length on off and angling across. Shaw looks to pull, and it's an out-of-control shot. Toe-ended to the boundary
full just outside leg and flicked off the pads to short fine leg. Man there
drilled to deep midwicket! Full ball just outside off. Shaw is quick to go leg side, and smacks it off his toes for four
full on off stump, and defended off the front foot. Ball rolls away to cover
good length on middle and off. Defended towards the off side

chance of a catch but ends up as a four! Good length ball on middle and he comes down the track before bunting a shot straight down. In the air past Bhuvi's left, and Holder at mid on can't slide to cut it off either
good length on leg stump and angling across to middle and off. Tapped away to cover
punished! Slot ball, on leg stump, and he beautifully clips it off his heel to fine leg for four!
full just outside leg stump from Bhuvi. He comes down the track to flick it leg side, but it hits his pads. Rolls away leg side

fullish on middle and leg. And clipped in front of square to deep midwicket past the infield. Early call for two, and it stays that way, but it could've been four if Rashid did not commit to a dive over there
defended back to the bowler off the back foot
full on middle stump, and he chips a lofted shot over Khaleel's head. Mid off runs around to cut it off
good length outside off stump. Skidding through to Saha as he misses the cut
good length just outside off but zips right in. Hits him near the glove as he looks to bring the bat down
good length on off and moving into middle and leg. Clipped off his waist to square leg to get the Capitals off the mark
